gaps.sentence: ___ problem is that people don't recycle enough.
gaps.explanation: The problem (the one we are discussing); people in general takes no article.

gaps.sentence: He drives ___ old van that is always breaking down.
gaps.explanation: 'An old van' — 'old' begins with a vowel sound. The second gap is 'the axle'.
'Have an eye for something' — fixed idiom with 'an'.

gaps.sentence: The car crashed into a wall at ___ speed of 90 km/h.
gaps.explanation: 'At a speed of…' — 'a' is part of this fixed phrase.

gaps.sentence: ___ Himalayas are among the youngest mountains on Earth.
gaps.explanation: Ranges like 'the Himalayas' take 'the'; single peaks take no article.

gaps.sentence: We had ___ wonderful time in Prague.
gaps.explanation: 'Have a wonderful/great/good time' — 'time' here is countable and takes 'a'.

gaps.sentence: ___ rich variety of birds lives in the Danube delta.
gaps.explanation: A rich variety of… — variety is countable here, first mention.

gaps.sentence: ___ sun sets much later in summer.
gaps.explanation: 'The sun' — there is only one, so the definite article is used.
